spec.description:
Kingspan Kooltherm K10 G2 Soffit Board is a premium performance, fiber-free
rigid thermoset closed-cell phenolic insulation board designed for concrete
soffit ceilings and exposed beam applications. Featuring an innovative composite
foil facing that achieves an NCC Group 2 fire classification without requiring
thermal barriers, it provides high thermal performance with a thermal
conductivity of as low as 0.021 W/m·K. Manufactured in Australia with zero ODP
blowing agents, it provides maximum thermal efficiency with minimal ceiling
thickness in commercial, residential, and institutional carparks and soffits.
features:
Rigid thermoset phenolic insulation with thermal conductivity as
low as 0.021 W/m·K

Ultra-thin profile maximizes ceiling height and carpark
clearance

Fiber-free closed-cell insulation core; non-deleterious and safe to
handle

Group 2 fire rating compliant with AS 5637.1 / AS ISO 9705 (Group 1
available with K10 Plus)

Certified by CodeMark (Certificate of Conformity)
for NCC compliance

FM Global approval (Class 4880 Class 1) for ceiling and
soffit applications

Available in silver reflective finish (K10 G2) or clean
white aesthetic finish (K10 G2W)

Unaffected by air movement and resistant to
the passage of water vapor

Manufactured in Australia with zero ODP and low
GWP blowing agents

install:
Inspect concrete soffit ensuring surface
is clean, dry, sound, and free of oil or contaminants

Mark grid pattern on
concrete soffit to ensure aligned joints

Fix boards with foil facing exposed
using proprietary insulation anchors with minimum 35mm diameter washers

Install a minimum of 5 to 6 mechanical fixings per board (located 100mm from
edges and across the center)

Butt board edges tightly together in a staggered
brick-bond pattern

Seal all board joints with Kingspan 48mm or 72mm
reinforced foil tape to maintain vapor and aesthetic continuity

Cut boards
neatly around service penetrations, conduits, and light fittings with a
fine-toothed saw or knife
selection_checklist:
Confirm NCC Section J
Total R-value requirement for the slab or roof

Verify fire group rating
requirement for the space (Group 2 for K10 G2; Group 1 for K10 Plus)

Select
finish (Silver K10 G2 for standard carparks; White K10 G2W for enhanced light
reflectance)
Calculate board count (each 2400x1200mm sheet covers 2.88 m²)
Specify matching mechanical anchors and 72mm foil tape
accessories: Concrete insulation anchors / pins with washer heads
limitations:
Must be
mechanically fixed; adhesive fixing alone is not permitted overhead on concrete
soffits

Not designed for external weather exposure without protective
cladding
Operating temperature must not exceed 100°C continuous exposure

retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Kooltherm K10 (K10 G2 / K10 G2W / K10 Plus) is an
Australian-manufactured rigid thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered for
concrete soffits, ceilings, and exposed beams. Featuring an ultra-low thermal
conductivity of 0.021 W/m·K and thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm (R1.2 to R4.75),
its slim profile maximizes ceiling clearance while satisfying NCC Section J
energy standards. Achieving an NCC Group 2 fire classification (Group 1 with K10
Plus) and FM Global approval, it delivers non-melting, fiber-free thermal
performance backed by a 10-year warranty.
